title: 6 Day Mount Kilimanjaro Marangu Route | Best Kilimanjaro Trek
description: The 6 Day Mount Kilimanjaro via Marangu Route, often referred to as the “Coca-Cola Route,” is one of the most popular and well-established paths to the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro (5,895m). This 6 Day Mount Kilimanjaro itinerary is unique for its comfortable hut accommodations, making it an excellent choice for trekkers seeking a well-supported climb without camping.

Starting from Arusha, the 6 Day Mount Kilimanjaro trek ascends through lush rainforest, scenic moorland, and stark alpine desert landscapes. An acclimatization hike to Zebra Rocks improves altitude adaptation and summit success. The climb culminates in a spectacular sunrise summit at Uhuru Peak, followed by a descent through verdant forest to Marangu Gate and return to Arusha.

itinerary.title: Arrival – Kilimanjaro International Airport to Arusha
itinerary.text: Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. Later, meet your professional mountain guide for a full trek briefing, safety orientation, and equipment check in preparation for the climb.

itinerary.title: Arusha – Marangu Gate – Mandara Hut
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Marangu Gate for registration and park formalities. Begin the trek through lush rainforest, home to waterfalls, birdlife, and colobus monkeys. Reach Mandara Hut for your first overnight stay on the mountain.Hiking Time: 5–6 hoursAltitude: 1,860m → 2,700m

itinerary.title: Mandara Hut – Horombo Hut
itinerary.text: Continue trekking through open moorland with giant heathers and sweeping views of the mountain. The gradual ascent allows time for acclimatization as you arrive at Horombo Hut, a spacious and comfortable base with excellent views of Mawenzi Peak.Hiking Time: 5–6 hoursAltitude: 2,700m → 3,720m

itinerary.title: Horombo Hut – Zebra Rocks – Horombo Hut (Acclimatization Day)
itinerary.text: Enjoy an acclimatization hike to the famous Zebra Rocks, named for their black-and-white striped appearance. Explore the surrounding alpine terrain before returning to Horombo Hut to rest and prepare for higher altitude.Hiking Time: 3–4 hoursAltitude: 3,720m → 4,050m → 3,720m

itinerary.title: Horombo Hut – Kibo Hut
itinerary.text: Trek across the saddle between Mawenzi and Kibo through stark alpine desert terrain. The landscape becomes increasingly rugged as you approach Kibo Hut, your base camp for the summit attempt. Spend the afternoon resting, hydrating, and preparing for the midnight ascent.Hiking Time: 5–6 hoursAltitude: 3,720m → 4,700m

itinerary.title: Kibo Hut – Uhuru Peak – Horombo Hut
itinerary.text: Begin the summit attempt around midnight, climbing steadily through the night. Reach Uhuru Peak (5,895m) at sunrise, the highest point in Africa, and enjoy breathtaking views. After celebrating your achievement, descend carefully back to Horombo Hut for a well-earned rest.Hiking Time: 12–14 hours

itinerary.title: Horombo Hut – Marangu Gate – Arusha
itinerary.text: Descend through moorland and lush rainforest to Marangu Gate, where you will receive your summit certificate. Transfer back to Arusha for relaxation and celebration.Hiking Time: 4–5 hours

itinerary.title: Departure – Kilimanjaro International Airport
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your onward journey home, marking the end of your Mount Kilimanjaro Marangu Route adventure.Meals: Breakfast
